name: Sink gasket 30 / 51
description: Ring, 30 mm inner and 51 mm outer diameter. Flat underside. The top has a 35 mm diameter recess with a flat floor that leaves the ring 1.8 mm thick around the hole, a raised lip 3 mm high around it, and a slope from the lip down to 0.6 mm at the outer edge. Print in TPU, flat side down.
